description: Ripple geometry metamorphic contracts and exhaustive fuzzy-skin selection gates.

mutants.description: The configured percentage is a fraction of a full 2π wave; quarter-offset and phase-group contracts should reject a half phase factor.
Ripple displacement must respond to configured thickness.
Arachne ripple displacement must preserve the configured amplitude.
Nonpositive and subresolution sample distances are documented no-op guards; valid distances must still sample.
Collapsed contours must remain unchanged while positive perimeters are ripple-sampled.

mutants.old:
for (size_t i = 0; i < np; ++i)

mutants.new:
for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < np; ++i)
        perimeter_mm += unscale_((poly[(i + 1) % np] - poly[i]).cast<double>().norm());
mutants.description: A closed ripple contour includes the closing edge in its period and sample count.
Each resampled point inherits the destination junction width.
Each resampled point inherits the destination perimeter metadata.
None and Disabled_fuzzy are explicit off switches across contour and hole combinations.
The first-layer gate includes layer zero unless explicitly enabled.
